2607.14631.title: Knowing You at First Glance: Inferring Apparent Personality from Faces
2607.14631.paper_summary: Inferring apparent personality from facial images is important in social scenarios for embodied agents in human-robot interaction. Unlike inferring intrinsic personality traits via conversation, this task models first-impression personality perception based solely on facial appearance before interaction begins. Existing studies mainly focus on the Big Five personality model and often rely on language or multimodal inputs. As a result, it remains unclear whether facial cues alone can support meaningful associations with perceived personality traits. This question is particularly relevant for MBTI types, which are widely used in practice and more readily interpretable by large language models. To this end, we propose \textbf{GlanceFace}, an end-to-end framework for apparent personality inference leveraging vision-language models to introduce semantic priors and a semantic-enhanced facial representation module to capture subtle personality-related cues, together with an uncertainty-aware learning strategy to handle noisy and subjective annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong performance on MBTI-based apparent personality benchmarks and reveal relationships between facial characteristics and perceived personality traits, highlighting its potential to support adaptive initial interaction strategies for embodied agents. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/MrHuan3/GlanceFace.
2607.14631.paper_summary_zh: 從面部影像推斷明顯的個性在社交場景中對於人機互動中的具身代理非常重要。與通過對話推斷內在個性特徵不同，這項任務僅基於面部外觀在互動開始之前建模第一印象的個性感知。現有研究主要集中在五大性格模型上，並且通常依賴於語言或多模態輸入。因此，目前尚不清楚僅僅依靠面部線索是否能支持與感知的個性特徵之間的有意義聯繫。這個問題對於MBTI類型特別相關，因為這些類型在實踐中被廣泛使用，並且更容易被大型語言模型解釋。為此，我們提出了\textbf{GlanceFace}，這是一個端到端的明顯個性推斷框架，利用視覺-語言模型引入語義先驗，並且有一個語義增強的面部表示模塊來捕捉微妙的個性相關線索，還有一種不確定性感知的學習策略來處理噪聲和主觀標註。廣泛的實驗顯示在基於MBTI的明顯個性基準上具有強大的表現，並揭示了面部特徵與感知的個性特徵之間的關係，突顯其支持具身代理的自適應初始互動策略的潛力。代碼和數據集可在 https://github.com/MrHuan3/GlanceFace 獲得。
